You own your skills, saved as a markdown file in your OneDrive.

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Natural language support for Scheduling prompts
events.titleJa: スケジュール プロンプトの自然言語サポート
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Natural language support for Scheduling prompts
events.summary: This feature allows users to simply express their intention conversationally, and Copilot infers their intention and creates a scheduled prompt automatically. We are unfortunately unable to move forward with this feature. We apologize for the inconvenience.
events.summaryJa: この機能により、ユーザーは単に会話で自分の意図を表現することができ、Copilot はユーザーの意図を推測して、スケジュールされたプロンプトを自動的に作成します。残念ながら、この機能の開発を進めることができません。ご不便をおかけして申し訳ございません。
events.summaryEn: This feature allows users to simply express their intention conversationally, and Copilot infers their intention and creates a scheduled prompt automatically. We are unfortunately unable to move forward with this feature. We apologize for the inconvenience.
